name: sme-fused-a-panel-four-step-row-pointers
hypothesis: Start from sme-fused-a-panel-staged-loads, the highest measured median. Unroll complete-tile reduction loops by four while retaining staged loads in pairs. Advance B pointers from row starts, so unconditional pointer updates remain valid and remove the previous per-pair end check. This reduces loop and address-control work without adding packing traffic. Keep the original A packing and predicated edge path. This candidate is untested; the supplied timing variation does not establish a reliable gain or the 1780 GFLOP/s target.
